verdict.rationale: The RX 9070 XT is a discrete GPU, and its ROCm software stack runs workloads locally; it is not a data-collecting service with a training-data policy, so an AI-training opt-out is a category error for this product. The 'private machine learning workstation' and 'secure alternative to cloud' marketing describes local execution, not a data-use control, so it is not credited.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
